verdict.rationale: Terraform ships an official MCP server that gives AI models real-time access to provider docs, modules, and policies, and a probe confirms it runs and responds to a JSON-RPC handshake — enabling AI assistants to generate more accurate Terraform code. However, this is an external integration point rather than a built-in natural-language-to-code generator inside the Terraform CLI itself, so it only partially satisfies the story.
